crm-activity-who: JS hook on styled table cell (activities.js querySelector for actor text updates)
crm-address-form: marker on styled .crm-identity-form; JS targets #crm-address-form by id
crm-aging-chip: data-attribute hook on styled .crm-badge (data-crm-aging-bucket carries the state)
crm-card--emails: variant marker on styled .crm-card; children carry crm-emails__* styling
crm-card__disclosure-label: shared base of the --open/--closed state variants; variant selectors carry show/hide styling inside styled .crm-card__disclosure
crm-company-essentials: section marker on NC-core .form-group inside the styled company form
crm-emails__mail-jump: layout-transparent group wrapper inside .crm-card__body; children (subheading/deep-links) carry spacing
crm-emails__related: layout-transparent group wrapper inside .crm-card__body; children carry spacing
crm-form-error: redundant marker on styled .crm-sales-inbox__create-error (danger-ink rule owns the look)
crm-get-app__features-block: layout-transparent section on .crm-get-app-page; the page flex gap owns inter-section spacing
crm-get-app__play-label: label span inside styled .crm-get-app__play button (inherits button chrome)
crm-glance-density--attention: variant marker on styled .crm-glance-density — attention arm renders the same block non-collapsible instead of details/summary
crm-jump-nav__list--more: variant marker on styled .crm-jump-nav__list inside .crm-jump-nav__more details; inherits list styling
crm-mailbox-compose__summary-title: label span inside styled .crm-mailbox-compose__summary (inherits title weight)
crm-mailbox-list-host: JS mount host — aria-live region filled by mailbox-settings-present.js
crm-page-actions-source: legacy relocation hook — components.js moves its buttons into #crm-page-actions
crm-personal-mail-account: JS mount host on .crm-stack (settings.js fills the connection panel)
crm-personal-mail-oauth: JS mount host on styled .crm-inline-actions (settings.js fills the OAuth actions)
crm-pipeline-deal-meta: marker on styled .crm-more-menu details in the deal row
crm-review-src-extra: conditional section wrapper toggled by data-review-extra; children are styled .form-group blocks
crm-sales-inbox__assign-form: marker on styled .crm-form; JS targets the form by id
crm-tab: marker on styled .crm-btn/.crm-sales-inbox__tab (tab chrome comes from the styled tab class)
crm-timeline__who: actor label inside styled .crm-timeline__meta row (inherits muted meta styling)
crm-workspace-context: marker on styled .crm-sr-only element (screen-reader-only workspace context)
